verdict: A very close, complete rebuild of the Main Page whose worst gaps are the wrong greys on the search border and tab underline plus a page-wide 1-2 px drift in text lines; it is editable, built from flex sections, but the shell is absolutely positioned and the colors are hard-coded.

top_defects.where: body text of both columns, section headings, Appearance panel
top_defects.what: nearly every text line and heading sits about 1 CSS px higher than the reference (the heatmap outlines all the text; grid cells 10-22 meanDiff across the columns); the welcome h1 uses a 32 px line height instead of 35.64 px and makes up for it with margins
border #a2a9b1 instead of #72777d, so the field reads lighter and flatter than the reference

top_defects.where: page tabs bottom rule, left column border
top_defects.what: the tab underline is darker than the reference's light grey (#a2a9b1, ref about #c8ccd1); the left column border is #c6e9d4, ref #cef2e0

top_defects.where: header: main menu and search magnifier
top_defects.what: the hamburger draws pure black, ref #202122/grey; the magnifier is darker than the reference's grey glyph
photo box 118x167.4 and its caption sit about 2 px lower and taller than the reference, so the caption baseline drifts
the four section headings and the two column panels are copy-pasted with the same long class strings; 261 arbitrary values and every color is a literal hex, with no tokens

top_defects.where: header, page tabs, main and Appearance aside
top_defects.what: the shell blocks are placed with absolute left/top (9 absolute layers), and both columns are fixed h-[640px] overflow-hidden, so adding content does not reflow the page

strengths: Every text of the reference is present and exact, accents included (Święczkowski, Sochański), with the same wrapping on every line
Measured surfaces match SOURCES: banner #f9f9f9/#dddddd, headings #cef2e0/#a3bfb1 and #cedff2/#a3b0bf, 18 px radios with #3366cc selected
The user links and the Appearance radio groups are templates driven by data, and the main blocks are named (Header, Search, Page tabs, Welcome banner, Left/Right column, Appearance menu)
